notes: The programme's own DAAD page states 'This programme has no deadline listed' and 'Submit application via Please check this website.', so no intake can be extracted. The fee shown is the DAAD-listed non-EU tuition fee (6,120 EUR per semester, 'Tuition fees may vary'); the institution-wide fees page only describes monthly fees per study format. The DAAD page gives no application platform for foreign-diploma applicants; the university's application-process page states applicants with a foreign university entrance qualification upload their documents to the university's own application portal, so de-university-direct is used (no uni-assist mention on any page). No document translation requirement is stated.
